paragraph: Nicole and Gary Wordsworth, a retired British couple in their 60s, spent fifteen years taking in dogs from Battersea Dogs Home in Buckinghamshire. They fostered fifty-nine pups while working from home designing electronics. Now they take part-time fosters. They say they love getting the dogs out of the kennels. They have no plans to stop.
